title: Father's bands: Excelsior, Imperial, Pirlists
summary: Father played big parades and with the Excelsior and Imperial bands; Arthur also knew Manuel Perez.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: No, he wasn't too old when he died. He got sick and died about a year later after my mother. But I remember the bands he played with, some of the bands, not all of them. He played a lot of the big parades and the feudals. He played with the Excelsa Band. He played with the Imperial Band. I think that's the band we have, the picture of the Imperial. It's either the Imperial or the Excelsa.
The Pirlists. The Pirlists. The Pirlists.
They had the Pirlists, the Imperial, and they had the Excelsa Band. I think you might have heard of that.
Yes, I've heard of all those bands.
You had the Imperial Band. I knew him.
